name: Coach mark
summary: A small spotlight callout anchored to one UI element, used for first-run onboarding or feature discovery. Dismissed by the user; never shown twice for the same step.

anatomy.purpose: The element the coach mark points at. Receives a highlight ring while active.
Short title + one-sentence body, max two lines each.
'2 of 4' when part of a tour sequence.
Primary 'Got it' or 'Next', plus 'Skip tour' when in a sequence.
Explicit close control; Escape also dismisses.

variants.name: Single
variants.use: One-off tip for a feature that is easy to miss.

variants.name: Tour step
variants.use: One step in a multi-step onboarding sequence.

whenToUse: First-run onboarding pointing at one real control.
Announcing a new feature in context, once.
Empty states where the next step is a single button.
whenNotToUse: Critical instructions the user must read to proceed: use a modal instead.
Passive hints that do not block or point: use inline text or a tooltip.
Showing repeatedly until clicked: one impression per step, ever.

keyboard: Tab reaches the actions in order; focus is not trapped because the dialog is non-modal.
When a tour sequence advances, focus moves to the next coach mark's primary action.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on all actions; the anchored element keeps a 2px focus/highlight ring at 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors.
notes: Non-modal: the rest of the page stays interactive; do not add a scrim.
Position must not cover the anchored control or the only route to dismiss.
Announce its appearance with aria-live=polite rather than moving focus abruptly, unless it is a tour step.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the entrance animation.
